name: Misaki (Okayama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Misaki town emblem in green and red: a green stylised letter M of two leaf-like strokes with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Misaki, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 2005.

features.role: Misaki town emblem — a green stylised letter M of two leaf-like strokes with a red disc
